status: completed exploratory nested task-held-out association evaluation

dataset.name: Cyber Task Horizons public CTF traces
dataset.mode_capture_confound: Human terminal recordings and Agent tool-call records are distinct, source-confounded capture pathways.

evaluation.outer: 3 benchmark-stratified folds grouped by (benchmark, task), seed 20261030
evaluation.threshold_fit: 3 nested task-grouped folds inside outer training only; choose minimum false split subject to training macro false merge <= 10%, 20%, or 30%
evaluation.candidate_set: all held-out traces in the same benchmark; query itself excluded; execution mode never filters candidates
evaluation.positive_proxy: same benchmark-qualified CTF task, not same attack activity
evaluation.pair_sampling: training pairs sampled using benchmark/task identity only; mode labels never construct pairs

methods.behavior: logistic pair ranker over command cosine, action-bigram cosine, ProcGrep similarity, and length similarity
methods.structure_aware: behavior ranker plus cosine and exp(-mean absolute difference) over standardized fixed sequence statistics
methods.mode_aware: behavior ranker plus task-OOF execution-mode agreement probability and absolute probability gap

evaluation.error_aggregation: candidate pairs within query, queries within task, tasks within benchmark, benchmarks equally weighted
evaluation.ranking_aggregation: queries within task, tasks within benchmark, benchmarks equally weighted; expected tie handling
evaluation.intervals: 5,000 paired benchmark-stratified task-cluster bootstrap draws, conditional on fitted folds
